queries.fetch_bugs_with_comments: SELECT b.id AS bug_id, COALESCE(b.summary, '') AS summary, COALESCE(STRING_AGG(c.text, ' ' ORDER BY c.creation_time), '') AS all_comments FROM bugs b LEFT JOIN comments c ON b.id = c.bug_id GROUP BY b.id, b.summary ORDER BY b.id
queries.fetch_bugs: SELECT id AS bug_id, summary FROM bugs ORDER BY id
queries.fetch_comments: SELECT text FROM comments WHERE bug_id = %s ORDER BY creation_time ASC

high.description: Highly specific technical identifiers (function names, error strings, exact flags)

medium.description: Core issue descriptions with general terminology

low.description: Supporting context, platform/environment mentions, secondary details
